subtitle_policy: final/episode.srt is generated separately from final audio timing. Never burn-in, never embed as MP4 subtitle stream, never render via remotion-captions or any Remotion text overlay.

manim.fallback_policy: Every MANIM scene declares a validated non-Manim fallback (a build_diagram.py SVG spec). If the Manim render fails locally or in CI, the fallback renders instead; the swap is recorded in <asset>.fallback.json and surfaces in quality-check.json — never silent, never blocking.
manim.timing_policy: Animation beats are derived from measured step_frames in timing/timed-scenes.json (audio is the timing authority); narration speed is never altered to fit an animation.

notes: CRF 18-20 quality-based H.264 keeps thin code text readable (never starve the bitrate); audio AAC 128-160k.
